title: 100-foot triangular UFO over Colorado base captured in video Air Force won't release: sources
title_norm: 100 foot triangular ufo over colorado base captured in video air force wont release sources
snippet: A pair of classified videos allegedly showing a 100-foot black triangular UFO over a Colorado military base remain locked away despite President Trump's new order aimed at encouraging more UFO whistleblowers to come forward, according to sources.
